integrity: The proof is symbolic. The bundled verifier checks the index identities over a broad finite parameter grid and independently checks the source zero-pattern in its explicit F_9 example; those finite checks are supplementary rather than a substitute for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers full-length \(G_{k,s}(\alpha)\) with length \(2m\), dimension \(k\le m\), and a scaled trace-self-dual basis. It uses the source lemma establishing the Frobenius correlation zero pattern and distinguishes right and left \(e\)-Galois dual conventions; shortened locator sets or arbitrary bases are not addressed.
title: Complete Galois-hull profile of scaled generalized Gabidulin codes
